dedupe_keys.name: seznam avtobusnih postajalisc v mestni obcini velenje

description: Seznam avtobusnih postajališč v Mestni občini Velenje is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MESTNA OBČINA VELENJE. List of bus stops in the Municipality of Velenje. The database contains the name and location coordinate (GMAPS - WGS84). Coverage: MESTNA OBČINA VELENJE. The portal shows the English title as "List of bus stops in Velenje" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MESTNA OBČINA VELENJE. Its keywords include avtobusna postajališča. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX, CSV, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
